body: U+0023# Handover from the 2026-09-24 composer testing sessionU+000AU+000ARead `~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/E2E-TEST-PLAN.md` first; it holds the journeys, rules, environment facts, known state, and what worked and did not. This entry is the short version.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Where things stand**U+000AU+002D `feat/composer-editor-core` at 9b80901 contains all 21 composer PRs (#170 to #190). `flutter analyze` is clean and 2,913 of 2,913 tests pass. Main is untouched.U+000AU+002D macOS composer gates ran live for about half the scenarios; the results table is in the plan. Real defects: Ctrl+K does nothing; a floated photo dropped at a block boundary beside the float moves to the end of the note; a file-URL-only paste inserts nothing (check a real Finder copy); keystroke UI time p95 5.5 to 6.6 ms against 4 ms, and opening the 50k note takes 53 to 65 ms against 33 ms (budget misses, not user-visible). Owner-facing observations from the original audit (size parity, caret alignment, photo sizes, move semantics) are fixed.U+000AU+002D Android: the app does not build as the repository stands (file_picker 11.0.2 with AGP 9 and `android.builtInKotlin=false`); the test build uses `patches/android-probe-build.patch`. The composer header sits under the status bar. Only three composer scenarios ran before the owner stopped testing; restart Android from scratch.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Safety rules the owner set** (see the decision "Live-test input never leaves the device under test")U+000AU+002D Never inject input system-wide on the Mac. That froze the owner's I/O on 2026-09-24 and forced a restart.U+000AU+002D On Android, adb only. Keep the screen on from the probe build, not from phone settings.U+000AU+002D Ask before permissions, sign-ins, exports leaving the device, destructive actions on real data, system settings and downloads.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Tools installed this session with the owner's approval:** openjdk@17 (Homebrew), android-commandlinetools (Homebrew), SDK platform-tools, platforms 35 and 36, build-tools 36.0.0 and NDK 28.2.13676358, with the Android SDK licences accepted; Flutter is configured to use them.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Left on disk:** the old probe APK installed on the phone (not running); scratch worktrees `inproc` and `apkbuild` under the old session's scratchpad, which may be gone (the patches in the kit reproduce them); uncommitted `tool/probe/macos/drive.sh` harness fixes in the repo working tree.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Order:** Android A0 to A15, write the Android report section, then ask the owner for permission before any macOS work.
